note.windows: The first build takes about 45 minutes and about 4 GB. Python, pefile and capstone, CMake and Ninja are installed if they are missing; Visual Studio 2022 with 'Desktop development with C++' (the free Build Tools will do) must already be installed.
note.default: The first build takes about 45 minutes and about 4 GB. It needs 32-bit gcc, SDL2, SDL2_ttf and ffmpeg (i386) from your package manager; if any are missing it says which, with the command to install them.
